policies.name: booking_offers_participant_operations_read
policies.using:
((driver_id = uid()) OR has_admin_capability('operations'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE ((b.id = booking_offers.booking_id) AND (b.tourist_id = uid())))))

policies.name: reviews_participant_capability_read
policies.using: ((tourist_id = uid()) OR (driver_id = uid()) OR has_admin_capability('operations'::text) OR has_admin_capability('finance'::text) OR has_admin_capability('support'::text))

policies.name: route_changes_participant_operations_read
policies.using:
((requested_by = uid()) OR has_admin_capability('operations'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE ((b.id = booking_route_changes.booking_id) AND ((b.tourist_id = uid()) OR (b.driver_id = uid()))))))

policies.name: stops_participant_capability_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE ((b.id = booking_stops.booking_id) AND ((b.tourist_id = uid()) OR (b.driver_id = uid()) OR has_admin_capability('operations'::text) OR has_admin_capability('finance'::text) OR has_admin_capability('support'::text) OR ((b.status = 'pending'::booking_status) AND has_active_booking_offer(b.id, uid()))))))

policies.name: bookings_participant_capability_read
policies.using: ((tourist_id = uid()) OR (driver_id = uid()) OR has_admin_capability('operations'::text) OR has_admin_capability('finance'::text) OR has_admin_capability('support'::text) OR ((status = 'pending'::booking_status) AND has_active_booking_offer(id, uid())))

policies.name: cash_participant_finance_read
policies.using:
((actor_id = uid()) OR has_admin_capability('finance'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE ((b.id = cash_confirmations.booking_id) AND ((b.tourist_id = uid()) OR (b.driver_id = uid()))))))

policies.name: dispute_statements_participant_capability_read
policies.using:
((author_id = uid()) OR has_admin_capability('finance'::text) OR has_admin_capability('support'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (disputes d
     JOIN bookings b ON ((b.id = d.booking_id)))
  WHERE ((d.id = dispute_statements.dispute_id) AND ((b.tourist_id = uid()) OR (b.driver_id = uid()))))))

policies.name: disputes_participant_finance_read
policies.using:
(has_admin_capability('finance'::text) OR (opened_by = uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE ((b.id = disputes.booking_id) AND ((b.tourist_id = uid()) OR (b.driver_id = uid()))))))

policies.name: history_participant_operations_read
policies.using:
((driver_id = uid()) OR has_admin_capability('operations'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE ((b.id = driver_location_history.booking_id) AND (b.tourist_id = uid())))))

policies.name: current_location_participant_operations_read
policies.using:
((driver_id = uid()) OR has_admin_capability('operations'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE ((b.driver_id = driver_locations.driver_id) AND (b.tourist_id = uid()) AND (b.status = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::booking_status, 'ongoing'::booking_status]))))))

policies.name: assigned_driver_profile_read

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1

policies.check: ((bucket_id = 'driver-documents'::text) AND is_pending_driver_application() AND (name = ANY (ARRAY[((uid())::text || '/license.jpg'::text), ((uid())::text || '/vehicle-registration.jpg'::text)])) AND valid_image_object(name, metadata, 5242880, true))
